title: Experts disagree on new .github/workflows/plugin-eval.yml
context:
Chief architect: the three claims are complementary; this one states the whole job shape and the gate the settled notes fix; dispatch-and-weekly-only is carried by the triggers conflict above and install-and-build-first by accepted EX-devops-engineer-4

Target: new .github/workflows/plugin-eval.yml
- product-owner: the CI pipeline runs the eval only on manual dispatch and weekly, never on every push or PR, because every case is a paid model call
- application-architect: the plugin hooks run node on runtime/hooks/*.mjs and the bin under runtime/claude-plugin/bin, which reach into dist/; the workflow must install and build (pnpm build) before claude plugin eval, or every with-plugin case fails for a reason that is not paqad's behaviour
- application-architect: the workflow runs three tagged invocations (routing with no tool grant, firewall with Edit Write, receipt with Edit Write Bash), each with --threshold 0 and its own --json, then one score script gates on the with-arm mean per suite (routing and firewall >= 0.9) and fails on partial results
